title: Guest page
description: Visitors who open this page are registered automatically under a guest account.

gate.failed: The guest account could not be created: the sign-in service did not return a session. The page does not retry by itself, so that no extra records are created.

blocks.text: Visitors who open this page are registered automatically under a guest account.

blocks.title: Keep in mind
blocks.text: Every guest visit adds a new record to the database. If you decide to offer this, be careful: it puts real load on your application. Use it only where it is truly necessary.
